title: Delivery, Quality, and Reliability Intelligence
description: Calculate governed engineering metrics and identify evidence-backed bottlenecks, regressions, recurring risks, and improvement opportunities.
setup_prompt: Use Delivery, Quality, and Reliability Intelligence with my reconciled engineering data. Apply my metric definitions and team boundaries, calculate reproducible trends, investigate only supported changes, and produce evidence-backed findings without individual productivity scoring.

setup_inputs.label: Reconciled Engineering Data Foundation or equivalent model
Analysis and comparison windows plus business calendar
Customer metric definitions, targets, and exclusions
Minimum freshness, coverage, and confidence policy

recommended_tools.name: AgentWorks workflow database
recommended_tools.purpose: Read normalized engineering records and persist reproducible metric snapshots and findings

recommended_tools.name: Source-control MCP
recommended_tools.purpose: Verify authorized PR, review, commit, and check evidence behind a finding

recommended_tools.name: Issue, CI, deployment, and incident MCPs
recommended_tools.purpose: Verify authorized source records when normalized evidence is incomplete or ambiguous
